# Noto Sans JP

Regular and Bold OpenType fonts from the official Noto CJK repository:

- https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/tree/main/Sans/SubsetOTF/JP
- https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/blob/main/Sans/LICENSE

Downloaded 2026-09-26. Original binary files, unmodified. See LICENSE.txt
for the SIL Open Font License 1.1 and font metadata for copyright attribution.
Both browser rendering and PDF embedding use these local files. Only used
glyphs are embedded in each exported PDF; no external font requests are made.
